tui.shortcuts: F1–F6 pages  / search  Tab focus  Enter open  F8 reload  ? help
tui.help:
F1–F6: pages   F8: reload
Tab / Shift-Tab: focus controls   ↑↓: move   PgUp/PgDn: scroll
/: search   Esc: cancel/search reset   Enter: open/confirm
n: import profile   r: refresh   Space: pause connections/logs
d: remove/close selected item (confirmation)   Ctrl-C: close interface
Input: Ctrl-U clears; arrows edit; bracketed paste supported.
m: cycle mode   t: toggle TUN   s: toggle system proxy
tui.input_hint: Tab switches fields · Enter submits · Esc cancels
